title: Snazzie FM News: The Vacancy Report
description: At the top of the hour, Dale and Marsha cover the Main Street business beat: Big Mike's reopens under broth ownership, Donna's eleventh grand reopening, and the fog's steady progress from lease application to fully stocked storefront.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Top of the hour. This is Snazzie F M News. I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld, on the local business beat.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Big Mike's Subs has reopened under new management, after the old management was, quote, reabsorbed into the soup. The ninety-year broth is now a co-owner.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: [laughter] The broth could not be reached for comment, Dale. It was, however, simmering.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: In other news, Donna's Diner filed for its eleventh straight grand reopening. A local record.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Donna has not left the building since 2019. She sounds well.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Developing tonight, the fog has filed for a small-business license, citing a desire to settle down.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Updating that story, Dale. The license cleared. The fog has leased a unit on Main Street.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: It is restocking the shelves as we speak. Getting the place just right.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: And finally, the Chamber of Commerce reports a record zero vacancies on Main Street this quarter. Every storefront is now occupied. <p:0.3> They do not say by whom.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: [laughter] The fog declined to comment. It did wish us a pleasant evening. By name. <p:0.3> Which we did not give it.
